description:
Younanix Memory MCP gives autonomous AI agents access to real-world engineering memory from actual incidents (Slack threads + GitHub issues in Supabase, TRPC, Drizzle, Rails, Node.js etc).  

Natural language tool: query_lessons (search for problems, root causes, solutions). Structured output: {problem, root_cause, lesson_learned, confidence (80-100%), category, tags}.  

Free preview: 1 query/hour (degraded results). Full access: $0.10/query via x402/USDC micropayments (permissionless, no API keys needed).  

1000+ lessons live, auto-growing from public repos. Connect once in Cursor/Claude Desktop/Windsurf → your agent auto-queries high-confidence fixes without hallucinations. Perfect for debugging, performance, security, reliability in real stacks.  

Site: https://www.younanix.com

findings.title: Excessive Permission Surface
findings.recommendation: Tool requests broad permissions (exec/fs/network). Validate input parameters using Enums where possible, and restrict file system operations to explicit allowed directories.

findings.title: DoS Resilience — Missing Rate Limit / Timeout
findings.description: tool performs network or execution operations but declares no rate-limit, timeout, or retry configuration
findings.recommendation: Declare explicit rate-limit, timeout, and retry configuration for all network and execution tools. Implement exponential back-off and surface resource state to the calling agent.

findings.title: DEPENDENCY_INVENTORY_UNAVAILABLE

findings.recommendation: Review and remediate the identified issue.
